title: A Python pilot repository delivers five tasks through krn lane run with hidden tests
body:
Why: AR:280, DEC:88; all evidence is TypeScript
Outcome: An operator-owned Python repo with green pytest is adopted by PR; five tasks merge via `krn lane run`; hidden tests written before each lane and kept outside the worktree; a table of canary verdict, lane $, turns, hidden verdict in the task
Proof: `.krn/runs/pilot/hidden/grade.sh` per task prints PASS/FAIL; `gh pr list --state merged` shows 5. Also `npm run fast` PASS.
Size: split: decision, adopt PR, five lanes
After (plan): t-djnrw3t 5/5, t-78j7smx, N03
Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan.md section 2 (plan id N01).
